briefdescription.para: END-private colour identifiers.

detaileddescription.para: Keyed by LookAndFeel::setColour / findColour for components that have no JUCE-native colour id. Components sourcing JUCE-native ids (CaretComponent, TextEditor, ScrollBar, ResizableWindow, juce::TextButton, juce::Label) use those directly — this enum covers END-only components only.

briefdescription.para: Packed window glass parameters from the active theme.

detaileddescription.para: Returns { argb colour, blur radius, windowFX style } packed into Union<uint32_t, int16_t, int16_t>. Consumer unpacks via structured binding. Returns zeros when theme is not loaded.

briefdescription.para: Rendering-context typeface registry and shared glyph atlas.
Rendering-context style table — self-registers as jam::Stamp::getInstance().
Rendering-context grapheme cluster table — self-registers as jam::Grapheme::getInstance().
Singleton config model reference — source for theme path and top-level config values.
Theme subtree reference from the config model — source for all per-component colour and metric values.
JUCE embedded font ownership — Ptrs kept alive so font names resolve via juce::Font name lookup without requiring system-installed fonts.
Parsed SVG assets keyed by their GRAPHICS property id or button state identifier.

detaileddescription.para: Each entry is a SVG::Flex::Segments set (9-slice layout, paint-ready) produced by SVG::Flex::getSegments from the SVG file named by the matching property in the IDtype::graphics ValueTree. Rebuilt by loadGraphics() on construction and on every SVG file-change event.

Keys are either:
GRAPHICS property identifiers (ID::tabBar, ID::tabHighlight) for the bar background and sliding highlight assets, or
tab-button state identifiers (jam::ID::normal, jam::ID::over, …) for the per-state button Segments, one entry per authored state slot.

briefdescription.para: Event dispatch map keyed by juce::Identifier (property or tree type).

detaileddescription.para:
Populated by registerEvents(). Handles:
ID::theme — full theme rebuild via initialiseColours()
IDtype::graphics — SVG asset reload via loadGraphics()
IDtype::tabButton — SVG asset reload via loadGraphics()
IDtype::code, IDtype::scrollbar, IDtype::tab, jam::IDtype::button, jam::IDtype::overlay, IDtype::pane, IDtype::statusBar, IDtype::hint — per-component colour refresh via setColours()

briefdescription.para: Registers typefaces, initialises colours from theme, loads SVG graphics, registers events, and adds listeners to config and theme.
Removes listeners from theme and config.
Single-key event dispatch through the events map.

detaileddescription.para: Checks whether property has a registered handler; if not, falls back to tree.getType(). Routes theme rebuild (ID::theme), SVG reload (IDtype::graphics, IDtype::tabButton), and per-component colour refresh to their respective callbacks.

parameterdescription.para: The identifier of the changed property.

briefdescription.para: Renders the tab bar background using SVG Flex segments (ID::tabBar).

detaileddescription.para: Applies a rotation AffineTransform for vertical orientations: -90 degrees for left-side bars, +90 degrees for right-side bars.

briefdescription.para: Renders the tab highlight indicator using SVG Flex segments (ID::tabHighlight).

detaileddescription.para: Applies a rotation AffineTransform for vertical orientations: -90 degrees for left-side bars, +90 degrees for right-side bars.

briefdescription.para: Renders a tab button using the per-state SVG from the sparse graphics bank.

detaileddescription.para: State is resolved via jam::SVG::Button::getState and mapped to a jam::map::ButtonState identifier. Paint occurs only when that state slot was authored in the theme.lua graphics section (sparse bank — missing states are silently skipped). Applies rotation transform for vertical bars.

parameterdescription.para: True when the pointer is over the button.
True when the primary mouse button is held on the button.

briefdescription.para: Tab label rendering — uses getTabFont() and getTabText() from theme config.

detaileddescription.para: No border, centred, colour from Label::textColourId (synced by Tab::buttonStateChanged).

briefdescription.para: Returns tab font constructed from theme config (family, size, kerning).

detaileddescription.para: Reads IDtype::tab properties: ID::fontFamily, ID::fontSize, ID::kerningFactor.

briefdescription.para: Returns horizontal padding in pixels per side of the tab label.

detaileddescription.para: Reads tab.text_padding from the display config (user-configurable).

briefdescription.para: Display transform applied to a tab label before measuring and painting.

detaileddescription.para: Reads tab.uppercase from the display config; returns toUpperCase() when set, identity otherwise. Consumed by both Bar::getBestTabLength (measurement) and drawTabButton (render) so measured width and painted string never diverge.

briefdescription.para: Component-level padding for the tab bar from display config.

detaileddescription.para: Reads tab.padding { top, right, bottom, left } (CSS convention).

briefdescription.para: Pane resizer bar — SVG Flex rendering with pane colourIds.

detaileddescription.para: Hover/pressed state swaps bar colour to highlight colour.

briefdescription.para: Registers embedded JUCE typefaces and builds the composite code typeface with platform emoji and nerd-font fallbacks.

detaileddescription.para: JUCE side: creates Typeface::Ptrs from JAM embedded binary data and stores them in typefaces so font name lookup resolves without system-installed fonts. JAM side: constructs a jam::Typeface for the code font family from theme, adds platform emoji fallback (Apple Color Emoji / Segoe UI Emoji / Noto Color Emoji), DisplayMonoBook nerd-font fallback, SymbolsNerdFont fallback, and a DisplayMonoBold style variant. Defined in EventRegistration.cpp.

briefdescription.para: Parses SVG assets from the theme graphics directory into SVG::Flex::Segments.

detaileddescription.para: Iterates the theme ValueTree recursively, reads each file listed in the ID::graphics property, resolves the key as a button-state identifier when the filename suffix matches jam::map::ButtonState, or as the filename stem otherwise. Stores the resulting jam::SVG::Flex::Segments in graphics, keyed by that identifier. Colour map for each tree node is sourced from the matching child of colourMap, falling back to the root colourMap. Defined in EventRegistration.cpp.

briefdescription.para: Builds ColourMap from theme state and applies all component colours.

detaileddescription.para: Calls jam::ColourMap::fromValueTree on the theme state, then maps every component-tree colour property to its corresponding JUCE or END ColourId via setColourId (code, scrollbar, tab, button, overlay, pane, statusBar, hint). Finalises by calling setColours on the full theme state. Defined in EventRegistration.cpp.

briefdescription.para: Populates the events map with ValueTree property/type-keyed callbacks.

detaileddescription.para:
Registers handlers for:
ID::theme → initialiseColours()
IDtype::graphics → loadGraphics()
IDtype::tabButton → loadGraphics()
IDtype::code, IDtype::scrollbar, IDtype::tab, jam::IDtype::button, jam::IDtype::overlay, IDtype::pane, IDtype::statusBar, IDtype::hint → setColours(theme.state) Defined in EventRegistration.cpp.

briefdescription.para: END's look-and-feel — theme-driven rendering with live ValueTree updates.

detaileddescription.para: Inherits jam::LookAndFeel::Methods for tab bar background, highlight, button, and resizer rendering. Listens to both the config root ValueTree and the theme subtree for live theme changes.

Event dispatch uses a single-key lookup: property key takes priority; when no event is registered for the property, the lookup falls back to tree.getType(). This routes theme rebuild (ID::theme), SVG reload (IDtype::graphics, IDtype::tabButton), and per-component colour refresh (IDtype::code, scrollbar, tab, button, overlay, pane, statusBar, hint) through one code path.
